design_philosophy: Simple and functional. Built for speed. Dense data, no frills, pure utility.

layout.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
layout.surface_strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid. High density, 1px solid borders (`border-neutral-800`), flat backgrounds, absolutely no shadows or glassmorphism. Sharp corners (`rounded-none` or max `rounded-sm`).

components.buttons: Square edges, crisp 1px borders, high contrast. Use semantic colors for actions (e.g. Red for Stop/Kill).
components.cards: border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-900/50 p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-sm
components.tables: Dense. Use `text-sm`. Headers should be uppercase, tracking wide, text-neutral-500. Rows must have `border-b border-neutral-800`. Numbers MUST use `font-mono`.
components.inputs: bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-neutral-100 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 rounded-sm
components.badges: px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase border rounded-sm

motion.philosophy: Instantaneous. Snappy. No slow fades. Transitions should be 100ms max to feel 'built for speed'.

testing.required_attributes: All interactive elements, forms, and data display rows MUST use `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="start-bot-btn"`, `data-testid="wallet-balance"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for a technical, crisp look.
Use Recharts (yarn add recharts) for the P/L sparkline. Keep the chart minimal (no grid lines, no axes), just the trend line.
Construct the dashboard strictly using Tailwind CSS and customize Shadcn components to remove large border-radii and shadows.
The layout must have a prominent top status banner (Green for RUNNING, Amber for PAUSED, Red for KILLED).
Implement the 'Daily loss meter' as a linear progress bar that fills with red as it approaches the $20 limit.
Active trades and Recent launches should be auto-updating lists, visually distinct. Recent launches can have a pulsing green dot to indicate 'live' status.
For all numerical data (prices, P/L, addresses), explicitly apply the mono font classes to ensure tabular alignment.
Do NOT use arbitrary padding/margin, stick to the Tailwind spacing scale (e.g., p-2, p-4, p-6).
